error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not display this page. Please try again; if the error persists, send the request ID below to support.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be wrong, or this feature is not enabled for your organization.

invitation.subject: Invitation to {tenant}
invitation.text:
You have been invited to join {tenant}.

Open the link to set your password and authenticator app. The link is valid for 72 hours and can be used once:
{url}

If you did not expect this invitation, ignore this message.

passwordReset.subject: Password reset
passwordReset.text:
A password reset was requested for your account.

Open the link to set a new password. The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once:
{url}

If you did not request this, ignore this message — your password stays the same.

common.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again; if it persists, send the request ID below to support.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this network. Wait a minute and try again.
common.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long phrase beats a complicated word.
common.passwordTooShort: The password must have at least {min} characters.
common.continueHint: Signed in. If the page does not open by itself, click Continue.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email and password. Next we ask for a code from your authenticator app.
login.firstTime: First time here? Accounts are created only by an invitation from your organization’s administrator — open the link in the invitation.
login.invalid: The email or password is incorrect, or access is temporarily blocked after several failed attempts. Check your details and try again in 15 minutes; if you forgot your password, contact your administrator.

mfa.title: Verification code
mfa.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for this account.
mfa.invalid: The code is incorrect or has expired. Enter a new code from the app; after 5 wrong codes verification is blocked for 15 minutes.
mfa.expired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again with your password.

mfaSetup.title: Set up your authenticator app
mfaSetup.intro: Every sign-in asks, in addition to your password, for a code from an app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password). Setup takes a minute and is done once.
mfaSetup.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
mfaSetup.manualTitle: Can’t scan? Enter the key manually
mfaSetup.manualHint: In the app choose “enter a setup key”, type “time based”.
mfaSetup.openApp: Open in an app on this device
mfaSetup.backupHint: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. Keep them off this device — we will not show them again.
mfaSetup.codeTitle: 3. Enter the code from the app
mfaSetup.codeInvalid: The code is incorrect. Check that the time on your phone is correct and enter a new code.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.setPassword: Set a password for signing in. After that you set up your authenticator app.
invite.invalidDescription: The invitation was already used, was revoked, or the link is incomplete. Ask your organization’s administrator for a new invitation.
invite.expiredDescription: Invitations to {tenant} are valid for 72 hours. Ask your organization’s administrator for a new one.
invite.existingDescription: This email already has an account. Sign in, then open the invitation link again to accept it.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in with a different account. Sign out and sign in with the account from the invitation.
invite.doneDescription: Sign in with the password you just set.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After the change, every other device where you are signed in will be signed out.
password.done: Your password was changed. Other devices were signed out.

tenants.title: Choose an organization
tenants.description: You are a member of several organizations. Their data is fully separated; you can switch later.
tenants.emptyDescription: Your account is not active in any organization right now. Ask your organization’s administrator to invite or reactivate you.
tenants.forbidden: This organization is no longer available to you. Refresh the page.

errors.unauthorized: Your sign-in has expired or is incomplete. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.forbidden_origin: The request did not come from the application and was rejected.
errors.not_found: The requested item does not exist or is not available to you.
errors.invalid_request: The request contains invalid data. Check the fields and try again.
errors.conflict: The item was changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.not_pending: This invitation is no longer pending.
errors.already_member: This person is already an active member of the organization.
errors.user_disabled: This user is deactivated. Reactivate them instead of sending a new invitation.
errors.unknown_role: The selected role does not exist in the organization.
errors.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask your administrator for a new invitation.
errors.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
errors.sign_in_required: This email already has an account. Sign in, then open the link again.
errors.wrong_account: You are signed in with a different account than the invitation’s.
errors.captcha_failed: The check that you are not a robot failed. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests from this network. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.approval_required: The change was sent for approval by another person (four eyes).
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large (at most 5 MB and 20,000 rows).
errors.file_unreadable: The file cannot be read — save it as CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX.
errors.no_valid_rows: There is no valid row to import.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again; if it persists, send the request ID to support.
errors.self_action: You cannot do this to your own account — ask another administrator.
errors.last_owner: This is the organization’s only owner; make someone else owner first.
errors.not_ready: The PDF is still being prepared. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.unsupported: This kind of request cannot be decided here yet.

dashboard.title: Collections overview
dashboard.description: All figures are in {currency}, as of today in the company's time zone, and cover only the customers you can see.
dashboard.missingFx: {n} invoices without an exchange rate are not included

overdue_total.label: Overdue total
overdue_total.definition: Sum of open amounts of invoices whose due day has ended (company time zone), in the reporting currency.

open_total.label: Open total
open_total.definition: Sum of open amounts of all open invoices, overdue or not.

dso.label: DSO
dso.definition: Open total (adjustments added back — they are not collections) ÷ average daily invoiced amount of the last {window} days.

promises_today.label: Promises today
promises_today.definition: Number and sum of pending promises dated today.

promises_broken.label: Broken promises
promises_broken.definition: Promises broken in the last 30 days: by the day after the promise date, less than the promised amount was paid.

collected_30.label: Collected (30 days)
collected_30.definition: Sum of payments received in the last 30 days. Adjustments (credit note, write-off, source correction) are not collections and are excluded.

collection_rate.label: Collection rate
collection_rate.definition: Collected (30 days) ÷ (collected + overdue total), in percent. Adjustments are excluded.

aging.title: Aging distribution
aging.definition: Open amounts by days overdue (buckets from settings).

work.title: My work today
work.definition: Promises falling due, scheduled next actions and open cases.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Once you import invoices from your accounting system, the customers and items that need attention appear here, ordered by priority. The first step is the import.

importPage.title: Invoice import
importPage.description: CSV or Excel (XLSX) from your ERP. Map the columns once — the next import from the same source remembers them. File content is only checked, never executed.

file.title: Choose a file
file.hint: CSV (UTF-8, separator ; or ,) or XLSX, first sheet, up to 5 MB and 20,000 rows.
file.columns: Required columns: invoice ID, number, invoice date, due date, amount, customer tax ID and name. Open amount, currency and country are optional.
file.label: Invoice file

mapping.title: Column mapping
mapping.template: The mapping of the previous import was applied.

codes.invalid_amount: amount is not a valid number
codes.due_before_issue: due date is before the invoice date
codes.invalid_currency: currency is not an ISO code
codes.invalid_country: country is not an ISO code
codes.duplicate_in_file: the same ID repeats in the file

report.title: Import report
report.failed: Processing the import failed. It is retried automatically; if it happens again, contact support.
report.summary: New invoices: {created}, updated: {updated}, unchanged: {unchanged}. New customers: {customers}. Skipped rows: {skipped}.
report.rollbackConfirm: Undo the import? Invoices nobody has changed will be removed.

exceptionKinds.paid_invoice_changed: amount of a paid invoice changed
exceptionKinds.open_amount_increased: open amount is higher than before
exceptionKinds.customer_changed: invoice now belongs to another customer
exceptionKinds.rollback_blocked: invoice was changed meanwhile — not undone

wizard.rolledBack: Import undone: {reverted} reverted, {blocked} left to decide.

history.title: Import history
history.empty: No imports yet. Export your customers' open items from the ERP to CSV or Excel and load them above.
history.counts: {rows} rows · {valid} valid · {created} new · {updated} updated · {exceptions} to decide

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.description: This page needs a permission your role does not have. If you need it, contact your organization’s administrator.

users.title: Users
users.description: Who works in the organization, with which role and scope. New users join only by invitation; deactivation deletes nothing.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.name: Full name
invite.sent: The invitation was sent. It is valid for 72 hours.
invite.none: You are not allowed to invite users.

users.resent: A new invitation was sent; the previous link no longer works.
users.deactivated: The user was deactivated and no longer has access.
users.approvalRequested: Changing an owner/administrator role waits for approval by another person.
users.approved: The change was approved and applied.
users.emptyTitle: It is just you for now
users.emptyDescription: Invite colleagues from finance and collection — everyone gets only the role they need.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.description: Language, time zone, currency and country apply to the whole organization: deadlines and daily jobs (e.g. 06:00 your time) follow the time zone, legal parameters follow the country.
settings.readOnly: Settings can be changed by the owner or an administrator.

status.title: System status
status.description: Database and background jobs (sending messages, processing events, cleaning old data). Read-only.
status.notStarted: The worker has not started on this database yet.
status.dailyRunQueued: The daily job has started; rule results show up within a minute.
status.dailyRunHint: The same job that runs every day at 06:00 in the company time zone: promises, overdue invoices and rules. Running it again creates no duplicates.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: A team decides what someone with “team” scope sees: customers of teammates and customers assigned to the team. Everyone is in at most one team.
teams.name: Team name
teams.noFreeMembers: All active users are already in teams.
teams.emptyDescription: Create teams (e.g. by region or portfolio) so that collectors with “team” scope see their colleagues’ customers.
teams.emptyMembers: The team has no members yet.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Changes that need a second person (four eyes): owner/administrator roles and role permissions. Until a request is approved, the old state applies.
approvals.emptyDescription: When someone proposes a role or permission change, the request appears here and another person decides.
approvals.notYours: You may not decide this kind of request.
approvals.proposed: The request was sent; the change applies only after approval.
approvals.legalHandover: Hand a case over to legal

pwa.installHint: Works from your phone’s home screen too.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Customers you can see, ordered by overdue debt. Search by name, tax ID or ERP code.
customers.emptyDescription: Change the search or filters. If you have not imported invoices yet, customers are created by the import.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.definition: Open amount of invoices past their due day.

oldest.label: Oldest
oldest.definition: Most days overdue among overdue invoices.

customer360.missingFx: {n} invoices without an exchange rate are not included

empty.activities: No activities — log the first contact.
empty.documents: No documents — create a payment reminder or a statement with the buttons above.

case.noInvoices: The customer has no open invoices.

payment.created: The payment is recorded and allocated to invoices.

caseScreen.title: Case · {stage}
caseScreen.legalHint: The handover is approved by another person (four eyes). Until then the case keeps its stage.
caseScreen.legalRequested: The handover request was sent for approval.
caseScreen.legalPending: Handover to legal is awaiting approval.

rules.title: Collection rules
rules.description: Rules run collections automatically: WHEN something happens, IF the conditions hold, THEN the actions run. Every change is a new version and goes live only after another person approves it.
rules.newDescription: A rule starts as a draft (version 1). After saving, send it for approval — only then does it run.
rules.emptyDescription: The standard collection policy is added when the organization is set up. Create the first rule with the button above.
rules.runs7d: 7 days: done {succeeded} · conditions not met {skipped} · errors {failed}
rules.pendingNotice: This version awaits another person's approval (Administration → Approvals). Until then the published version applies.
rules.invalidDefinition: This version's definition is not valid — save a new version.
rules.runsEmpty: The rule has not run yet.
rules.name: Rule name

triggerHelp.days_from_due: Every day after 06:00 in the company's time zone: invoices whose due date plus the days is today.
triggerHelp.event: When the event happens (events caused by rules never trigger rules).
triggerHelp.no_activity: Every day: customers with overdue debt and no activity for that many days — once per inactive period.
triggerHelp.specific_date: Once, on that date: customers with open invoices.

rules.ifHelp: All conditions must hold. Amounts are in the reporting currency with a dot as decimal sign (e.g. 1000.00).

actionHelp.create_case: An existing open case of the customer is reused.
actionHelp.create_task: The task goes to the case owner.
actionHelp.queue_email: Sending email awaits a decision on message kinds in the mail outbox.
actionHelp.change_stage: The 'Legal' stage only through an approved handover.
actionHelp.escalate: Notifies managers and the team lead.
actionHelp.create_decision: Always only a proposal — a person approves (rule 19).
actionHelp.create_approval: A proposal; a person submits the handover request from the case (rule 11).
actionHelp.call_webhook: Off until the feature flag is enabled.

rules.saveAndSubmit: Save as a new version and send for approval
rules.submitted: Sent for approval; the rule runs once another person approves it.
rules.runFailed: The run failed — nothing was changed.

documents.unsafe: The document contains content that is not allowed and is not shown.
documents.pdfPending: The PDF is being prepared — refresh the page in a few seconds.
documents.pdfRequested: The PDF has been requested; it appears here once the worker has made it.
documents.downloadLogged: The link is valid for 5 minutes and only for you; every download is recorded in the export log.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.description: Broken promises, customers without activity, large overdue invoices, approvals, tasks, failed rules and import exceptions — each with the next step.
attention.empty: Nothing is waiting for you right now.

kinds.rule_proposal: Rule proposal waits for a person

messages.rule_decision_proposed: a proposed decision awaits a person

attention.submitted: The proposal has been sent to another person for approval.

templatesAdmin.title: Templates
templatesAdmin.description: Email and document texts (payment reminder, statement) per language. Every change is a new version; documents remember the version they were made from.
templatesAdmin.empty: No templates — the defaults are added when the organization is set up.
templatesAdmin.legalEffect: with legal effect — a rule never sends it to a private person
templatesAdmin.subject: Subject ({locale})
templatesAdmin.body: Text ({locale}) — allowed tags: p, br, strong, em, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, table, span, div; no attributes
templatesAdmin.saved: A new template version was saved.
